# Cube Design System (Web)

> Web docs for Cube, in the same preview as component galleries and typical pages. Foundation components are HeroUI v3 with the Cube theme. Cube components are `@bosagent/cube-ui`. Mobile previews use `#Mobile/Button`. MCP and Agent Skills are not available.

## Guide

- [概览](/llms/index.md)
- [快速接入](#Docs/getting-started/quick-start)
- [设计基础](#Docs/foundations)
- [色彩](#Docs/foundations/color)
- [主题](#Docs/foundations/theme)
- [排版](#Docs/foundations/typography)
- [间距](#Docs/foundations/spacing)
- [圆角](#Docs/foundations/radius)
